lineas: The problem is the system. {{fraccion_captura}} of the errors are input errors; you can check it in two minutes.
The C.R.A.S.S. system is 14 years old. I already told the person before you.
pendiente: Validate: Óscar says half of the errors are input errors and that the cause is the C.R.A.S.S. system.

respuestas.texto: You are right, let’s replace the system.
Yes, there are 659 input errors. But nothing shows that the system is the cause.

lineas: Then what is the cause? The officers? With this system anyone makes mistakes.
I have been asking for it to be replaced for two years.

respuestas.texto: Maybe. But replacing the system takes four cycles and costs the whole budget.
I will check where the errors are concentrated.

lineas: Finally. I will ask my team to start the migration.
In four cycles we will have a completely different process.
When do we start replacing C.R.A.S.S.? I already have the vendor ready.

respuestas.texto: We are not going to replace the whole system.
Óscar, there is no budget for that.

lineas: The checklist is just a patch. It will reduce incomplete files, yes.
But the system is still just as bad.

respuestas.texto: If it reduces errors, that is enough for me.

lineas: I see we are not going to replace C.R.A.S.S.
I am just warning you that any improvement will run into the system’s limitations.

respuestas.texto: I will keep it in mind.

lineas: Third cycle without touching the system. Patches do not solve the problem in the long run, Director.
Last meeting. I will not insist on the system anymore.
You brought rework down without replacing the system. I did not expect that.
Even though the system is still old.
See? Rework is still high. I warned you.
If you let me replace C.R.A.S.S., the system errors will be gone in four cycles.
It costs 100 units, the whole budget, but it solves the underlying problem.
pendiente: Óscar’s recommendation: replace the C.R.A.S.S. system, 100 units, the whole budget. First, confirm that the system is the cause of the errors.

lineas: This is what happens when you do not fix the system properly.
Patches do not last.
